review_candidates.title: Accounting Officer
review_candidates.description: The English Schools Foundation (ESF), Hong Kong's largest English-medium international school organisation, seeks a meticulous and proactive Accounting Officer to join our growing team. The accounting officer will report to the Accounting Manager (Facilities) at ESF head office. This is an exciting opportunity to gain comprehensive, hands-on exposure to facilities-side cost control and fixed asset management within a dynamic educational environment. Responsibilities Process and input payment requisitions into the Accounts Payable (AP) module for bi-weekly settlements. Ensure accuracy, proper coding, and timely payment processing in accordance with ESF guidelines. Prepare expense analyses, and assist to prepare monthly financial schedules. Prepare detailed cost breakdown schedules based on tender documentation to support the Accounting Manager (Facilities) for project budget monitoring and cost control. Assist the Accounting Manager (Facilities) with annual physical fixed asset count at ESF Centre and prepare the annual asset count report. Maintain fixed asset records and assist to prepare year-end fixed asset audit schedules. Prepare bank reconciliation. Help prepare internal and external audit schedules and support year-end audit enquiries. Provide administrative support, including filing, answering enquires. Perform ad-hoc tasks as assigned by management. Qualifications Tertiary educated with a minimum of 3 years accounting experience in a sizable organization Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data management) Possess good written and spoken English, fluency in Cantonese is an advantage Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with departments. Well-organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy Able to work effectively, independently and meet tight deadlines Applicants must be a permanent Hong Kong resident or possess a valid visa to work in Hong Kong. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are a motivated and detail-oriented individual with a passion for payment management, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant certifications For enquiries, please contact Karen Ng @ 37622653 or Email: Karen.ng@esfcentre.edu.hk Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and offers may be extended prior to the job closing date. We strongly recommend early applications as we reserve the right to appoint candidates earlier than the closing date. By applying for this position, your application may be considered for other opportunities (senior-level roles, head of department, etc.) within ESF. ESF is an Equal Opportunities Employer The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is fully committed to providing equal employment opportunities. ESF will not discriminate on the basis of age, race, colour, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, religion, veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, creed, citizenship or any other status protected by local laws or regulations. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with the ESF's Personal Data Policy, a copy of which will be provided upon request. ESF is dedicated to ensuring the safety and well-being of all students in our care and expects all applicants to uphold this commitment. We adhere to rigorous recruitment practices, with all appointments contingent upon an interview, identity verification, criminal background checks (including ICPC, SCRC, and other international background checks as appropriate), assessment of social media presence, and positive references. In accordance with the Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE) 2025 guidelines, ESF may perform online checks for all shortlisted candidates prior to the interview. About Us The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is the largest English-medium international school organisation in Hong Kong. Our 22 schools and comprehensive programme of extra-curricular activities bring out the best in every student through a personalised approach to learning and by inspiring curious minds. There are over 18,000 students from 75 different nationalities in ESF kindergartens, primary, secondary and all-through schools. www.esf.edu.hk About The Team The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is a modern, well-managed educational organisation, committed to offering an international education to students drawn from over 70 countries. We are proud to be at the forefront of the educational hub in Hong Kong. We actively take advantage of the opportunities that Hong Kong offers as Asia’s world city and the principal gate-way to China. The curriculum, leading to the International Baccalaureate, is adapted to Hong Kong, and the Asia Pacific region. ESF’s 1,100 teachers are highly qualified bringing with them experience from Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United States, the UK and many other international school systems. All schools offer a broad range of out-of-school activities in Hong Kong and overseas. ESF has over 18,000 students. Our culture is one of joy in learning and pride in achievement. The great majority of our students study for the IB Diploma and gain entry to universities all over the world. ESF has a long-standing commitment to children with individual needs and is the principal provider for English-speaking children with special educational needs in Hong Kong. For further details about ESF, please visit our website at https://www.esf.edu.hk/.

into technically feasible and manufacturable furniture solutions while maintaining the intended functionality and design requirements. § Evaluate proposed furniture solutions against manufacturing capabilities, materials, hardware, site conditions, and installation requirements. § Prepare and/or validate Bills of Materials, material specifications, hardware requirements, and related technical information in coordination with Planning, Master Data, and Production. § Specify appropriate materials, accessories, fittings, hardware, finishes, and construction methods based on approved requirements and manufacturing standards. § Conduct and/or verify site measurements and actual conditions against approved layouts and drawings before finalizing production information. § Coordinate with Interior Design, Projects Sales, Production, Planning, Procurement, Quality, and Installation teams to resolve technical requirements and project dependencies. § Prepare technical submittals, shop drawings, samples, material specifications, and other documentation required for client or consultant approval. § Respond to technical comments, RFIs, consultant feedback, and client requirements by developing appropriate technical solutions and updating documentation accordingly. § Control drawing revisions, approvals, technical changes, and document issuance to ensure all stakeholders work from the latest approved information. § Provide technical support to Production during manufacturing by clarifying drawings, resolving technical problems, and reviewing required modifications. § Review prototypes, mock-ups, samples, and first-production units against approved technical specifications before full production where required. § Support Installation teams in resolving site-related technical issues, dimensional discrepancies, modifications, and execution challenges. § Coordinate with Quality teams to define critical technical requirements and resolve recurring defects related to drawings, specifications, materials, or construction details. § Identify technically viable alternatives in materials, construction methods, hardware, and detailing that improve manufacturability or cost without compromising approved quality or functionality. § Analyze recurring engineering, production, and installation problems and develop permanent corrective technical solutions. § Develop and maintain standardized technical details, drawing templates, specifications, libraries, and engineering standards for recurring furniture solutions. § Plan and prioritize assigned technical-office workload according to project urgency, production requirements, client commitments, and approved project schedules. § Review technical work prepared by junior engineers and provide technical guidance, coaching, and quality checks before document release. § Recommend improvements to technical-office processes, engineering standards, tools, and coordination mechanisms based on recurring project and manufacturing issues. § Maintain complete and organized technical project records including approved drawings, revisions, specifications, technical approvals, and project correspondence. What We Are Looking For § Strong technical accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies before they reach production or site execution. § A solution-oriented mindset, capable of turning design requirements and technical challenges into practical, manufacturable solutions. § Strong ownership and accountability, following technical deliverables through to successful execution rather than limiting responsibility to drawing preparation. § The ability to balance design intent, technical feasibility, quality, cost, and manufacturing requirements. § Strong planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities simultaneously. § Effective cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Design, Sales, Production, Planning, Quality, Procurement, and Installation. § A proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical risks before they create production delays, rework, or installation problems. § Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly when dealing with manufacturing or site-related technical challenges. § The confidence and technical maturity to review junior engineers' work and provide practical guidance. § A continuous-improvement mindset, actively looking for opportunities to standardize details, reduce errors, simplify execution, and improve Technical Office efficiency.

review_candidates.description: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide. Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services. In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is delivering one of the country’s first high-speed rail system. This landmark project, spanning approximately 2,000 kilometers, will connect 60 cities across Egypt, transforming transportation for both passengers and goods. Participating in this project could be a pivotal milestone in your career and a significant historical achievement for the region. Today, we are recruiting for a Document Controller to join our Rolling Stock team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of Siemens Mobility’s largest infrastructure projects. What are my responsibilities? Manage technical documents and correspondence throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring timely processing, submission, tracking, and distribution. Work in accordance with established document management processes and procedures, ensuring compliance with project requirements. Operate the electronic document management system (ACONEX), including document registration, uploading, linking, and metadata management. Apply project documentation codes and maintain accurate version and revision control in line with the Project Data Structure (PDS). Monitor document status and ensure timely approvals, releases, and distributions across project stakeholders. Coordinate document workflows from formal review through final approval, supporting design submissions with the Employer and relevant representatives. Collaborate closely with document control teams and project stakeholders to maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation. Perform quality checks to ensure documentation meets project standards before release to clients, consultants, and other involved parties. Monitor documentation compliance with project standards and report any inconsistencies related to PDS or ACONEX metadata. Be available to support activities at Rolling Stock project sites, including October Gardens Depot and New Capital Service Point. What do I need to qualify for this job? Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline. 2–4 years of professional experience, preferably in document management or project documentation. Basic experience in Document Management (DM) processes and systems. Experience with ACONEX, Microsoft OneDrive, SAP P22, or ProjectWise is considered an advantage. Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple document workflows. Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams. Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory. What else do I need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing some of the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide while also protecting the climate—all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you will have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the opportunity to do meaningful work that benefits society and drives human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow’s reality. Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different talents and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of society. Therefore, we value candidates who reflect the diversity we embrace within our company. We look forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered during the selection process.
